proposed_geometry.derivation: Mechanical union of all polygon features in the pinned A.D. 14 AWMC-derived GeoJSON after ST_MakeValid; no historical boundary editing. Public render remains subject to the canonical Natural Earth land/render pipeline.
proposed_geometry.temporal_fit: A.D. 14 historical snapshot used as the nearest specialist geometry for the 14–22 CE slice; no interpolation beyond that bounded interval.

source.reliability_limitations: Historical GIS reconstruction rather than a surveyed boundary. The source coastline is not the atlas physical-land authority and must still pass render normalization. The exact political status of client kingdoms/frontier zones is not inferred from polygon inclusion alone.

Rejected after semantic testing. Its layers are incremental expansion layers; cumulative use at A.D. 16 preserves temporary holdings in Germania/Armenia, while the A.D. 16 feature alone omits the Roman core.

notes: This review changes geometry only. It does not strengthen the slavery claim, alter P-level, infer uniform control within the polygon, or alter the canonical v0.8.0 release. Promotion requires a new immutable release and serving materialization.
